name: Trelane's Ember Agate
summary: Trelane's Ember Agate is kept in a chest within a tower in Arathi Highlands. Skuerto at Refuge Pointe seeks it alongside two other relics belonging to Trelane.

sections.title: The Agate
sections.body: Within the tower in Arathi Highlands, Trelane's Ember Agate rests in a chest. Skuerto at Refuge Pointe asks you to recover it with Trelane's Orb and Trelane's Phylactery. Ogres guard the tower, so the search is not without danger.

faq.answer: Trelane's Ember Agate is in a chest within a tower in Arathi Highlands.
Skuerto at Refuge Pointe asks you to bring back Trelane's Ember Agate, along with Trelane's Orb and Trelane's Phylactery.

faq.q: What else is in the tower?
faq.answer: Trelane's Orb and Trelane's Phylactery are also sought from chests in the tower.
Ogres guard the tower where Trelane's Ember Agate is kept.
